name: busy-office
description: Busy Office skills for Claude Code: progress-dashboard (one-page stakeholder status), loop-doctor (design of a scheduled autonomous loop), loop-economist (what the loop's actual runs cost and produced) requeue (reprioritise and sharpen the queue the loop is fed) sharpen-intent (make the purpose document steer) loop-atlas (the loop as one picture, the crew as a card deck) wake-weight (what every run pays before it starts). Shape-detecting, read-only collectors with fixtures and a cross-collector drift check; reports graded by a blind critic against a written bar, with a mechanical pre-check that settles word budgets, headline figures against a fresh collection, and every citation.
